notes.title: UPDATE!
notes.content:
This was my first update ever! 

Initially, I thought I would just release this game, and never update it.  

I missed the days when you bought a video game, and it just was how it was.  
I wanted to challenge myself and improve the game though!

-Changed mission 1  

-Configured finishing missions to flow to the next mission. 

-A couple of missions have some hidden data to scrape or packages to scan  

Thanks for the support! 
Hope you enjoy getting the Choppers!
